		✨Dataset Summary
	

S2R-HDR is a large-scale synthetic dataset for high dynamic range (HDR) reconstruction tasks.  It contains 1,000 motion sequences, each comprising 24 images at 1920×1080 resolution, with a total of 24,000 images.  To support flexible data augmentation, all images are stored in EXR format with linear HDR values.
